Thus,  great  being,  invifible  fupreme  difpofer  of  our  race,  I lay  at  thy  feet  the

thou  wilt  gradually  unfold  them  to  thy  creatures,  and  exhibit  them  in  nobler  forms.

The  law  of  retaliation  is  an  eternal  ordinance  of  nature.  As  in  a balance  nei-
